name: el-sueno
description: EL SUEÑO — Capítulo I: La Ciudad Vacía. Браузерный психологический хоррор-квест для изучения испанского.

scripts.test:walk: node build.js && python3 tests/e2e_walk.py && python3 tests/e2e_walk_mobile.py
scripts.test:all: node build.js && python3 tests/e2e.py && python3 tests/e2e.py m && python3 tests/e2e_walk.py && python3 tests/e2e_walk_mobile.py && python3 tests/e2e_saves.py
scripts.test:setup: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m playwright install chromium
scripts.deploy: npm run build:site && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy site --project-name=${CF_PAGES_PROJECT:-el-sueno} --branch=main
